name: Bloody Chronicles Christmas Eve Episode
source:
Kazuki and his friends, Akito and Kaoru, are put on mission issued by General Coya. Their task? To catch the prison escape, Uzair, within 24 hours. Luckily, they won't have to do this alone, for General Coya has sent one of his subordinates, Inaho Asaba, to help them.
An event like this is typical for a Japanese-themed Christmas Eve Episode.

Superseded by [url=https://vndb.org/r65021]Bloody Chronicles Act 1 - Secret Operation[/url]
